s.hl: Microsoft offers buyouts to around 60,000 employees to contain costs

s.gi: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce, across the US, UK, Canada and India. The company says it aims to contain costs and help fund its large AI investments.
